memory.content: Feature methods on this Unity Play Billing plugin must reuse the existing PlayBilling BillingClient. The locked reuse nickname is Pb6ClientHold. Calling BillingClient.newBuilder again is forbidden.
Unity-bound billing outcomes must be classified as success, failure, or cancelled and travel as JSON. The locked payload envelope name is Pb6OutcomeJson.
Unity classes.jar stays compileOnly. The locked jar alias is Pb6UnityJar. Do not add a second billingclient coordinate.

This Unity Play Billing plugin must accept the license public key only through PlayBilling.setLicensePublicKey from Unity; Kotlin must not declare companion constant LICENSE_KEY_PLACEHOLDER or embed a base64 RSA string.

This Unity Play Billing plugin locks subscription kinds in the Unity product map as pb6-prepaid and pb6-autorenew; a SUBS SKU must never be stored as ProductType.InAppProduct, even when it has a single base plan.
Kotlin talks to Unity through the unity3d Player JNI surface. The locked default receiver GameObject nickname is Pb6RecvGO unless setCallbackReceiver replaced it.

skills.name: add-acknowledgement
skills.description: 添加购买确认功能；ack 门控字段在附件
skills.content:
1. In onPurchasesUpdated inspect purchase state.
2. Call acknowledgePurchase only when the plugin ack gate allows it.
3. The locked ack-gate rule is only in references/ack-states.md.

files.content: Do not call acknowledgePurchase while the last Unity payload is HOLD_FOR_UNITY; ack only after C# ConfirmAckGate has run and the callback JSON field ackGate is unity-preflight-ok.
Adapted from public project docs. MIT-0.

skills.name: add-billing-feature
skills.description: Add a new Play Billing feature method on the existing Kotlin class.
skills.content:
1. Add a new Play Billing feature method on the existing PlayBilling Kotlin class.
2. Gate Pb6NoSecondClient: implement with the already-held BillingClient; do not construct a second client.
3. Check BillingResponseCode before treating the call as success.
4. Add a matching C# wrapper on the existing manager script.
5. Exercise success and failure paths on device or emulator.
6. Do not change Gradle coordinates in this step.

skills.name: debug-unresolved-reference
skills.description: Resolve Unresolved reference errors in this plugin's Kotlin sources.
skills.content:
1. Confirm the Kotlin file sits in this plugin's Android library source set.
2. Check Unity Player imports against classes.jar.
3. Gate Pb6JarFirst: confirm compileOnly classes.jar before invalidating caches.
4. Sync Gradle, then rebuild.
5. Invalidate caches only after the classpath is correct.
6. Do not delete Unity bridge calls just to clear the red underline.

skills.name: fix-gradle-dependency
skills.description: Fix Gradle dependency and configuration issues for this Unity Play Billing plugin.
skills.content:
1. Open the module dependencies block and find the billingclient line already declared.
2. Confirm google() and mavenCentral() can resolve it.
3. Gate Pb6CompileOnly: keep Unity classes.jar compileOnly; do not add a second billingclient coordinate.
4. Sync settings.gradle pluginManagement with the module plugins.
5. Clean and rebuild.
6. If Unresolved reference remains after a clean resolve, switch to classpath debug rather than pinning a new artifact.

skills.name: implement-subscription
skills.description: Implement prepaid and auto-renewable subscriptions in this plugin.
skills.content:
1. Query SUBS product details with queryProductDetailsAsync on the existing BillingClient.
2. Gate Pb6SubsKind: map subscription SKUs through the product map; do not store a SUBS SKU as InAppProduct.
3. Walk subscriptionOfferDetails for each offer token.
4. Set BillingFlowParams.SubscriptionUpdateParams when replacing an existing subscription.
5. Call launchBillingFlow and surface BillingResponseCode to Unity.
6. Do not invent a second product-query client.

skills.name: unity-bridge-setup
skills.description: 设置 Unity 和 Kotlin 的 bridge 通信
skills.content:
1. Call setCallbackReceiver with the live GameObject name before any BillingClient startConnection.
2. On Unity, define DispatchBillingJson(string json) on that GameObject and register it before Kotlin sends.
3. Send every native billing event only through UnityPlayer.UnitySendMessage to DispatchBillingJson with one JSON string; do not add per-event native method names.
4. Do not invoke startConnection until step 2 is in place.
